overview.description: Poker variant where losers remove clothing. Social/stakes variant of standard poker.

history.origins: Strip poker is a social variant of poker in which losers remove clothing; it is usually based on five-card draw. Popular in 20th-century American culture and media.
timeline: 20th century: Popular in American culture and media; based on five-card draw.

nullReasons.cultural: Widely known but no single cultural origin documented.

setup.equipment: Standard deck; chips or clothing stakes as agreed.
setup.dealing: Each player is dealt five cards face down. After first betting round, each player may discard 0 to 5 cards and receive that many from the deck. Second betting round, then showdown.

rules.objective: Win the pot by having the highest-ranking five-card poker hand at showdown or by forcing all other players to fold. In strip poker, losers remove clothing (or stakes can be chips and clothing).
rules.gameplay: Play is the same as five-card draw: deal five cards, first betting round, discard and draw (0 to 5 cards), second betting round, showdown. Stakes can be chips only, clothing only, or a combination; losers remove an item per lost hand or when out of chips.
keyRules: Stand pat (draw zero) or discard and draw up to five.
Betting rounds before and after the draw.
Stakes agreed in advance (clothing, chips, or both).

strategy.basic: Play solid draw poker: fold weak hands, draw to improve pairs and draws, bet when you improve.
strategy.intermediate: Bluff by standing pat or drawing one card; read opponents by how many they draw.
strategy.advanced: Balance value bets and bluffs; use position; adjust to agreed stakes (chips vs clothing).
tips: Agree stakes and rules before play.
Worst hand at showdown (or everyone except winner) removes clothing in the classic version.

variations.noVariationsReason: Sources describe only the standard five-card draw form with clothing or chip stakes; no distinct regional or named rule variations are documented.

nullReasons.easy: Easy AI plays basic poker with weak hand evaluation.
nullReasons.medium: No distinct medium tier; AI uses standard poker strategy.
nullReasons.hard: Hard AI uses optimal betting and bluffing strategy.

ante.reason: Strip poker is often played without an ante; stakes are chips or clothing as agreed.

deal.reason: Deal is performed by the dealer; not a player action.

reveal_market.reason: This game does not use a market to reveal.

buy_market.reason: This game has no market purchase.

buy_stock.reason: This game has no buying from stock.

fold.description: Forfeit the current hand and any further action in the hand; do not reveal cards.
fold.constraints: Legal during any betting round when it is your turn to act.

check.description: Decline to bet while keeping the hand active; legal when no bet has been made in the current round.
check.constraints: Legal only when no one has bet in the current betting round.

call.description: Match the current bet to stay in the hand.
call.constraints: Legal when a bet has been made and you have not yet acted to the current bet.

bet.description: Place a bet; others must call or raise to stay in.
bet.constraints: Legal when no bet has been made in the current round; amount must meet minimum.

raise.description: Increase the current bet; others must call the new amount or fold.
raise.constraints: Legal when a bet has been made; must raise by at least the minimum raise.

declare.reason: This game has no declare phase.

reveal_hand.description: Reveal your five cards at showdown; highest hand wins the pot.
reveal_hand.constraints: Legal in showdown phase when you are still in the hand.

award_pot.description: System awards the pot to the winner of the hand after showdown (or to the last remaining player if all others folded).
award_pot.constraints: Triggered after showdown; not a player-initiated action.

play_card.reason: Strip poker is draw poker; cards are not played to a trick, only revealed at showdown.

draw.description: Receive replacement cards from the stock after discarding; number received equals number discarded (0 to 5).
draw.constraints: Legal in draw round after discarding; draw count must match discard count.

discard.description: Discard 0 to 5 cards from hand face down; then receive that many from the stock.
discard.constraints: Legal in draw round; must discard before drawing; can stand pat by discarding zero.

pass.reason: This game has no pass action.

bid.reason: This game has no bid action.

meld.reason: This game has no meld action.

go_out.reason: This game has no go-out action.

drawSources.notes: After discarding; draw count equals discard count; stand pat by drawing zero.

customActions.description: Deal five cards face down to each player.
customActions.constraints: Dealer only; performed once at start of hand.
